def safe_evaluate(expression)
  # A simple parser for basic arithmetic expressions
  tokens = expression.scan(/\d+|\+|\-|\*|\//)
  result = tokens.shift.to_i

  while tokens.any?
    operator = tokens.shift
    operand = tokens.shift.to_i

    case operator
    when '+'
      result += operand
    when '-'
      result -= operand
    when '*'
      result *= operand
    when '/'
      result /= operand
    else
      raise "Invalid operator"
    end
  end

  result
end
